results.title: Expense Policy
results.heading: Non-reimbursable items
results.text: Alcohol, personal entertainment, traffic fines and parking fines are not reimbursable.

results.title: Expense Policy
results.heading: Home-office equipment
results.text: Home-office equipment up to $300 per year is reimbursable for full-time employees. This includes chairs, desks and monitors.

results.title: Expense Policy
results.heading: Contractor expenses
results.text: Contractors may claim travel costs only when pre-approved in writing by their manager. No other expenses are reimbursable for contractors.

results.title: Travel Policy
results.heading: Taxis and rideshare
results.text: Taxis and rideshare are reimbursable on business trips. Rental cars need manager approval.

results.title: Expense Policy
results.heading: Receipts
results.text: An itemized receipt is required for every expense over $25.
